company.name: mutherboard
company.description: mutherboard is a monday.com partner. We help companies get real value from monday.com.
company.services_note: Treat the 'services' list as everything mutherboard sells. 'services_not_offered' is for explicit exclusions (e.g. 'Reselling monday.com licences') - fill this in once confirmed. The scorer only penalises a clear promise of something outside the services list.

rate.note: PLACEHOLDER until a full rate card exists.

default_prospect_stance: The prospect assumes they can set monday.com up themselves. The rep has to earn the case for using a partner.
value_points: Faster time to value: a working setup in weeks, not months of trial and error.
Avoiding costly rework: poorly designed boards and automations often need rebuilding as the team grows.
Higher adoption: training and change management so the team actually uses it.
Expertise in integrations, automations and monday CRM that an internal admin rarely has.
Ongoing support through managed services, instead of one person becoming the bottleneck.

monday_pricing.verify_note: Check against monday.com's pricing page every quarter, then set last_verified (YYYY-MM-DD). These figures came from the original spec and have NOT been independently verified.

crm.note: monday CRM is a separate purchase.

monday_pricing.seat_bucket_note: Seats are sold in buckets (3, 5, 10, 15 and up), so a team of 6 pays for 10.

discount_rule.alternative: Extra hours instead of a discount.
